motion to adjourn was made, duly seconded and with no further discussion, meeting was adjourned at 7:22 pm.

decisions.decision: Director Oliva will speak with the Town Manager about an extension of the June 30th grant deadline and about bypassing the bid process to solicit bids from local contractors for the North Cemetery parking lot.
decisions.quote: director oliva said he would speak with the town manager to see if an extension is possible

decisions.decision: Director Oliva will work with the Superintendent on a grub treatment plan; grass restoration plans wait until the grubs are eliminated.
decisions.quote: director oliva stated that he would work with the superintendent to come up with a plan.

decisions.decision: Director Oliva will look at the problem areas of cracked cemetery roads and bring the matter to a future meeting.
decisions.quote: director oliva stated that he would take a look at the problem areas

decisions.decision: Director Oliva will report the remaining maintenance-budget balance for the cemeteries so the stump grinding at the Goodrich family burial yard can be scoped.
decisions.quote: once he has a number on the remaining balance in the maintenance budget for the cemeteries, he will let us know.

decisions.decision: A camera may be put up at North Cemetery to try to identify dog owners who do not pick up after their dogs.
decisions.quote: a camera may be put up to try and get an identity

decisions.decision: Chairman Tyler will draft a letter of thanks to Monty Tech for its help with the Holman St. garage and discuss it at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: he will draft a letter and discuss at the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The next meeting is to be scheduled after the May 15, 2021 Town elections and the swearing-in of a new commissioner, when the Commission will re-organize.
decisions.quote: next meeting to be determined as the town elections are may 15, 2021
